newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's Kim blasts France over Thomson deal.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's Kim blasts France over Thomson deal.

text.p: South Korean President Kim Young-sam on Tuesday blasted France over the scuttled sale of a unit of state-run Thomson SA to Daewoo Electronics, a presidential statement said.
"Because of that we have a bad impression of France and I have come to think France cannot be trusted," Kim told visiting French presidential envoy Jean-Claude Paye in a meeting, the statement said.

"The South Korean people believe we have been totally discriminated against. We hear the privatisation is being reviewed. It would be fortunate if the result is satisfactory. Otherwise there will be a major impact on Korea-French relations."
Paye was visiting Seoul to explain why Paris halted the sale of Thomson Multimedia to Daewoo Electronics, a move that sparked anger in Seoul.
He promised on Monday fair competition for the re-launched privatisation.
